articles.summary: Kodiak AI appoints retired U.S. Army Lt. Gen. Ross Coffman as a strategic advisor and will chair its new Defense Advisory Council. With deep expertise in ground autonomy, Coffman will help drive the deployment of Kodiak’s autonomous vehicle technology for national defense, strengthening Kodiak’s collaboration with the U.S. Department of Defense.
articles.title: Lt. Gen. (Ret.) Ross Coffman Joins Kodiak AI as Strategic Advisor and will Lead New Defense Advisory Council
